theorems.name: Submission.dohr_lmo_dema_withDensity_density_ae
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (ν : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (f : Amb n ℓ → ℝ≥0∞), IsLocallyFiniteMeasure ν → IsLocallyFiniteMeasure (ν.withDensity f) → AEMeasurable f ν → ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, ∀ c : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ν (closedBall y r) / c r) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (ν.withDensity f) (closedBall y r) / c r) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (f y))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
